name: Namsan Hike with T1gers
description:
Team1 Korea and Tiger Research are hosting a Namsan hike as part of KBW 2026 side events, on September 26, 2026.

Join us for a guided hike led by the Tiger Research & Team1 Korea - they've climbed Namsan over 100 times and know every good viewpoint along the way.


## 🎊 Event Info.

🙌 Co-host: 🔺Team1 Korea (https://x.com/AvalancheKorea) x 🐯Tiger Research (https://tiger-research.com/)

🗓 Date & Time: September 26 Saturday 10AM

📍 Location: National Theater of Korea (Google (https://maps.app.goo.gl/hobPFxXb13VmuVzn9), Naver (https://naver.me/Fqi65258))

🗺️ Itinerary


• 10:00-10:30 Reception & Registration
• 10:30-12:00 Guided Hike to Namsan Mountain
  • Enjoy iconic views of the Seoul skyline
  • Learning about the city's rich history
  • Reaching the summit
• 12:00-13:00 Descent & Cultural Stops
  • Visit the Observatory (Optional, tickets not included)
  • Descend the mountain
  • Explore nearby cultural spots with T1gers as your guide
• 13:00 Event concludes at the base of Namsan Park


## ⛰️ Hike Info.

🧡 Difficulty: Moderate, suitable for most fitness levels.

🧡 Distance: Approx. 4km (2.5mi) round trip

🧡 Duration: ~3 hours, including breaks, sightseeing, and chats

🧡 Please note:


• Wear comfortable hiking shoes.
• Bring water, snacks, and sun protection.
• In case of inclement weather, the event may be postponed or canceled.


## 🐯 About Tiger Research

Tiger Research is an independent research institution covering digital asset markets across Asia. Founded in 2022, Tiger Research has helped projects shape and distribute their narratives as one of Asia’s most referenced sources of blockchain intelligence and institutional connectivity. Its reports, published in five languages, reach 100,000 monthly subscribers and more than 200 institutional clients, including banks, asset managers, and enterprises.

Website (https://tiger-research.com/?utm_source=luma) | ​Research (https://reports.tiger-research.com/) | Linkedin (https://www.linkedin.com/company/tiger-research-inc/?utm_source=luma) | X (https://x.com/tiger_research_?utm_source=luma) | Youtube (https://www.youtube.com/@Tiger_Research?utm_source=luma) | Telegram (https://t.me/tiger_research?utm_source=luma)


## 🧩 About Team1

Team1 is a global network of builders, developers, creatives, & community members who grow Avalanche.

With 600+ members operating across 40 countries, Team1 drives the democratization and global adoption of Avalanche by onboarding new users and projects through local meetups, targeted workshops, exclusive side events, engaging content creation and community-led initiatives.

https://x.com/AvaxTeam1


## 🎁 Special Gift

Participants will receive a bandana. *First come, first served.

name: Tangem House — Seoul @ KBW2026
description:

🕕 Time: 6:00 – 10:00 PM 
📍 Location: Hashed Lounge 20F, Seoul 
🏠 Hosted by: Tangem

Join Tangem at Hashed Lounge to kick off Korea Blockchain Week 2026.

Enjoy a short Tangem introduction, a “Tangem & Friends” fireside with ecosystem leaders, and networking with Korea’s KOLs, builders, and communities.

Tangem Wallets and Rings will be on display, with giveaways across two raffle rounds. 🎁

Whether you are new to self custody or already run a hardware wallet, you are welcome.

🗓 Agenda


> 🚪 18:00 – 18:45 Doors, welcome drinks, product display
> 
> 🎤 18:45 – 18:55 What is Tangem?
> 
> 🔥 18:55 – 19:30 "Tangem & Friends" fireside with ecosystem friends <Panel lineup (TBA)>

>

> 
> 💍 20:20 – 20:30 Raffle Round 2 — Tangem Rings
>

⚠️ Please note:


• Registration is approval based. You will receive a confirmation once approved; please show your Luma QR code at check in.
• You must be checked in and present at the venue to win a raffle prize.
• Smoking indoors is strictly prohibited at the venue.
• If the venue reaches maximum capacity at any time, entry will be managed on a first-come, first-served basis.

We look forward to seeing you at Tangem House! 🙌

📍 How to Get Here

[Wayfinding 1: main gate / reception]


• After entering through the Main Gate, head to the left side of the Reception Desk.

[Wayfinding 2: elevator]


• There, you will find the elevator to the 20th floor.

About Tangem 🌍✨

Tangem builds the world's most user-friendly and secure hardware wallets designed as cards and rings. With EAL6+ certified chips, open-source code, and audited firmware, Tangem combines bank-grade security with everyday usability.

Self Custody in Your Pocket 💳

No batteries, no wires, no seed phrases. Tangem wallets activate in less than 3 minutes, work with your smartphone, and keep your private keys offline at all times.

Built for Web3 Freedom 🌐

With Tangem, you can hold, swap, and manage your tokens, all without trusting a third party. You remain in full control of your assets anywhere in the world.

Simple. Secure. Tangem. 🔒

Whether you're new to crypto or a seasoned investor, Tangem makes self-custody accessible to everyone.

🌐 Website (https://tangem.com/en/?utm_source=luma) | 🐦 X (https://x.com/Tangem?utm_source=luma) | ✈️ Telegram Korea

Tangem House — Seoul @ KBW 💳

>

⚠️ 안내드립니다:


• 본 행사는 승인제로 운영됩니다. 승인 후 확인 메일이 발송되며, 입장 시 Luma QR 코드를 보여주세요.

• 행사장 내 실내 흡연은 절대로 불가능합니다.

Tangem House에서 뵙겠습니다! 🙌

📍 오시는 길

[Wayfinding 1: 정문 / 리셉션]

[Wayfinding 2: 엘리베이터]


• 그곳에서 20층 베뉴로 오시는 엘리베이터를 찾으실 수 있습니다.

Tangem 소개 ✨

Tangem은 카드와 반지 형태의 하드웨어 지갑을 만듭니다. EAL6+ 인증 보안 칩, 오픈소스 코드, 외부 감사를 거친 펌웨어를 바탕으로 은행 수준의 보안과 일상적인 사용성을 함께 제공합니다.

주머니 속 셀프 커스터디 💳

배터리도, 케이블도, 시드 문구도 없습니다. Tangem 지갑은 3분 이내에 활성화되고, 스마트폰과 함께 작동하며, 개인 키는 항상 오프라인에 보관됩니다.

Web3를 위한 자유 🌐

Tangem을 통해 제3자를 신뢰하지 않고도 토큰을 보관하고, 스왑하고, 관리할 수 있습니다. 세계 어디서든 자산의 통제권은 온전히 사용자에게 있습니다.

Simple. Secure. Tangem. 🔒

크립토가 처음인 분부터 오랜 투자자까지, Tangem은 누구나 셀프 커스터디를 쉽게 시작할 수 있게 합니다.

name: The Bridge Summit
description:
🌉 The Bridge Summit 2026, 서울에서 여러분을 초대합니다

이번 KBW, 9월 28일은 The Bridge Summit에서 함께하세요.

TV조선 × Bridge34가 공동 주최하고, 글로벌 Web3 벤처캐피털 Hack VC가 Main Partner로 함께하는 The Bridge Summit 2026이 오는 9월 28일, 조선 팰리스 서울에서 개최됩니다.

Bridge34
· Bridge34는 글로벌 Web3 프로젝트와 한국 시장을 연결하는 Web3 전문 액셀러레이터이자 마케팅 파트너로, 커뮤니티·미디어·파트너십을 기반으로 국내 Web3 생태계의 성장을 이끌고 있습니다.

TV조선 
·  TV조선은 대한민국의 주요 종합편성채널로, 폭넓은 미디어 영향력과 콘텐츠 역량을 바탕으로 Web3와 디지털 자산 산업의 대중화를 연결하는 미디어 기업입니다.

Hack VC
·  Hack VC는 Web3 및 블록체인 기술에 집중하는 글로벌 벤처캐피털로, 초기 단계부터 유망한 프로젝트와 창업가에 투자하며 차세대 크립토 생태계의 성장을 지원하고 있습니다.

글로벌 Web3 프로젝트부터 기관, 투자자, 미디어, 그리고 한국 커뮤니티까지.
디지털 자산 · AI · 토큰화 금융의 다음 흐름을 만들어가는 플레이어들이 서울에 모입니다.

다양한 세션과 네트워킹, 프로젝트 부스는 물론, 이번 Summit에 참여하는 한국 커뮤니티를 위해 특별한 혜택도 준비되어 있습니다.

## ​About

Hyperliquid Seminar Korea is an invitation-only seminar hosted by HypurrCorea × TENET during Korea Blockchain Week 2026.

Korea's financial institutions are approaching a moment of change. As the FSC develops guidance on digital asset allocation, banks, brokerages, asset managers and listed corporates are being asked to form a view on markets they have had little structured exposure to.

This seminar is built for that audience. Over an afternoon, we examine what Hyperliquid is, how onchain markets actually function, what stands between an institution and participation today, and where the next twelve months lead. The session assumes no prior crypto background and is delivered to the standard institutional diligence requires.

Builders, researchers and the Korean Hyperliquid community join the same room.


## Program (Tentative)


• Why Hyperliquid, Why Now — Structural change in onchain markets and the rise of Hyperliquid
• From Exchange to Financial Infrastructure — Architecture, market model and ecosystem expansion
• Institutional Access to Onchain Markets — Regulation, KYC and custody, through to how institutions can participate
• The Next Chapter of Hyperliquid — Direction ahead and the next stage of onchain finance
• Networking

A curated group of C-suite executives and senior leaders from Korean banks, securities firms, asset managers, listed corporates and family offices, alongside leading builders, researchers and participants from across the global Hyperliquid ecosystem.

• Asset VIP 고객 및 적극적으로 가상자산 시장을 탐색하는 투자자

name: GWDC 2026 KOREA
description:
## 📅 Event Details / 행사 정보


• Date / 일시: Sep 29th - 30th, 2026 | 09:00 AM — 06:00 PM
• Location / 장소: AT Center, Seoul, South Korea (서울 aT센터)
• Official Website / 공식 웹사이트: www.gwdc.net (https://www.gwdc.net)

📲 Join the Community / 공식 커뮤니티 참여


• GWDC 2026 Telegram Group: t.me/Web3LabsHK (https://t.me/Web3LabsHK)



## 🚀 About Event / 행사 소개

Following the huge success of our inaugural event in Hong Kong this February, the 2nd Global Web3 Developer Conference 2026 (Global Web3 Dev Con) is officially landing in Seoul, expanding its scale to an unprecedented milestone!

Hosted by Web3Labs, GWDC is Asia's premier developer-focused Web3 summit. Taking place from September 29-30, 2026 (2 days) at the AT Center in Seoul, this mega-edition will champion the ethos of "For Builders, By Builders" on a much grander stage. This year, we are targeting 10,000+ Web3 enthusiasts, 200+ elite global developers, and 100+ tier-1 VCs for deep coding sessions, technical breakthroughs, and high-impact ecosystem exchange.

지난 2월 홍콩에서 성황리에 개최된 첫 대회에 이어, 제2회 글로벌 Web3 개발자 콘퍼런스 2026 (Global Web3 Dev Con)이 전례 없는 역대급 규모로 대한민국 서울에서 개최됩니다!

Web3Labs가 주최하는 GWDC는 아시아 최고의 개발자 중심 Web3 서밋입니다. 2026년 9월 29일부터 30일까지 이틀간 서울 aT센터에서 열리는 이번 대형 서밋은 "For Builders, By Builders(빌더를 위한, 빌더에 의한)"라는 핵심 이념을 더욱 거대한 무대에서 실현합니다. 올해 대회는 10,000명 이상의 Web3 애호가, 200명 이상의 글로벌 엘리트 개발자, 100개 이상의 탑티어 VC가 한자리에 모여 깊이 있는 코딩 세션, 기술적 돌파구 마련, 그리고 영향력 있는 생태계 교류를 펼칠 예정입니다.

Host : Web3Labs


## 💡 Event Highlights / 행사 하이라이트


• 10,000+ Mega Summit / 만인 규모의 글로벌 서밋: Connecting 10,000+ attendees worldwide, bringing together foundational layers, applications, and top-tier capitals under one roof. (전 세계 10,000명 이상의 참가자를 연결하고 하위 레이어 공공 체인, 상위 애플리케이션 및 최정상 자본을 한자리에 모으는 메가 서밋입니다.)
• Premier Hackathon / 프리미어 해커톤: 200+ global developers, 50+ breakthrough projects, real-chain tasks + top-tier mentor guidance + institutional VC judging. (200명 이상의 글로벌 개발자, 50개 이상의 혁신적 프로젝트가 참여하며, 퍼블릭 체인 실전 미션, 탑티어 멘토링 및 기관급 VC 심사가 함께 진행됩니다.)
• Global Innovation Exhibition / 글로벌 혁신 프로젝트 전시: 50+ Web3 innovative projects and direct VC matchmaking to accelerate global project launch, liquidity growth, and ecosystem building. (50개 이상의 혁신적인 Web3 프로젝트의 현장 노출 및 VC 직접 매칭을 통해 프로젝트의 글로벌 출시와 생태계 구축을 가속화합니다.)


## 🎤 Speakers & Agenda / 연사 및 아젠다

🌟 Confirmed Speakers & VIP Guests / 참석 확정 연사 및 VIP 라인업


• (More featured speakers will be announced continuously / 추가 연사 라인업은 지속적으로 업데이트될 예정입니다)




## 🌟 Agenda Focus Themes / 핵심 아젠다 하이라이트


• 🔥 AI Agents & Autonomous Payments / AI 에이전트 및 온체인 자율 경제 Exploring how AI agents utilize stablecoins for automated micro-payments to power a frictionless decentralized economy. (AI 에이전트가 스테이블코인을 활용해 자율 미세 결제를 수행하며 마찰 없는 탈중앙화 경제를 촉진하는 방향을 모색합니다.)
• 🌐 DePIN Commercialization / DePIN(탈중앙화 물리적 인프라 네트워크) 상용화 Driving real-world enterprise demand, revenue scaling, and sustainable token-burn mechanisms for hardware networks. (하드웨어 및 컴퓨팅 네트워크의 실제 기업 수요 창출, 매출 확장 및 지속 가능한 토큰 소각 메커니즘을 집중 조명합니다.)
• 📈 Tokenomics 2.0 / 토크노믹스 2.0 및 실질 수익 Shifting the paradigm from inflationary narratives to sustainable on-chain revenue models and fee-sharing mechanisms. (단순 내러티브와 인플레이션 덫에서 벗어나 온체인 바이백, 소각 및 수수료 분배를 통한 지속 가능한 실질 수익 모델에 주목합니다.)
• 💼 RWA & Institutional Capital / RWA(실물자산) 및 기관급 금융 Bringing traditional assets like T-bills and private credit on-chain to unlock deep liquidity and DeFi composability. (국채 및 사모 신용 등 실물자산을 토큰화하여 깊은 유동성을 확보하고 디파이(DeFi)와의 유기적 결합을 추진합니다.)
• 🧱 Modular Infra & Restaking / 모듈러 인프라 및 리스테이킹 생태계 Advancing the frontiers of shared security, modular scalability, and seamless omnichain interoperability. (기술적 돌파구를 깊이 있게 다루며 모듈러 블록체인, 리스테이킹 및 옴니체인 상호운용성 네트워크의 공유 보안 진화를 탐구합니다.)
• 📊 Prediction Markets & Derivatives / 예측 시장 및 탈중앙화 파생상품 Analyzing the structural growth of on-chain prediction aggregators and next-generation crypto derivatives. (온체인 예측 시장의 기하급수적 성장 트렌드와 차세대 탈중앙화 무기한 선물(Perp DEX) 및 파생상품 도구의 진화를 분석합니다.)


## 🤝 Collaboration & Sponsors / 비즈니스 협력 및 후원


• Host: Web3Labs
• Sponsors: (Updating soon... / 후원사 모집 중)

name: Open AGI Frontier: AI Meets Robotics with Open AGI Salon
description:
## Event Overview

As foundation models become increasingly commoditized, the AI industry is entering a new era — one defined by agents, applications, and infrastructure. Open AGI Salon is a curated, invitation-style gathering bringing together builders, investors, researchers, and thought leaders at the intersection of AI and Robotics.

Co-organized by Sentient, Axis, and Kaito, this event is designed to spark meaningful cross-sector conversations and collaborations that go beyond passive attendance.

🇰🇷 Korean participants must apply via Rocketpunch (국내 참가자 전용 신청 페이지):
👉 https://www.rocketpunch.com/event/EfCSDxQtQD


## Theme & Topics

The event explores the convergence of open-source AI and robotics — examining how autonomous agents, physical intelligence, and open infrastructure are reshaping industries and human-machine collaboration.


• The future of Open AGI and open ecosystems
• Agent-infrastructure and next-generation AI stacks
• Physical AI and the rise of intelligent robotics
• Scaffold design and its impact on agent performance and inference cost
• Building and scaling AI-native products
• Opportunities across the Asian AI and robotics ecosystem


## What Happens

2:00 PM | Doors open. Grab a drink. Meet the people building decentralized intelligence before anyone takes a stage.

3:00 – 4:00 PM | Introduction (Sentient, Kaito, Axis, Rocketpunch)

4:00 – 4:30 PM | Pannel Session 1

4:30 – 5:00 PM | Pannel Session 2

5:00 – 6:00 PM | Happy Hour


## About the Co-Hosts

Sentient Foundation

Sentient Foundation (https://sentient.foundation) is a non-profit organization dedicated to ensuring that Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) remains open-source and aligned with humanity. Guided by neutrality and transparency, Sentient promotes global adoption of open-source AGI, leads alignment and safety standards, provides grants to developers worldwide, and coordinates governance frameworks for responsible AI development.

Sentient Labs

Sentient Labs (https://sentient.xyz) is an AI research and product lab building AI systems capable of deep reasoning, continuous learning, and self-improvement. Its flagship product, EvoSkill, enables AI engineering teams to automatically evolve entire AI agents using only a model and a benchmark. Sentient Labs also runs AI engineering competitions on Sentient Arena, where top researchers compete to build the best harness-based agent solutions for the world's hardest AI reasoning problems.

Axis Robotics

Axis Robotics (https://axisrobotics.ai/) is building the Compounding Data Engine for Physical AI. We operate a large-scale distributed data network and a full-stack pipeline spanning simulation, egocentric data collection, pre-training, and real-time DAgger post-training. We have built a global distributed contributor community and a scalable data production infrastructure designed to continuously generate high-quality training data for Physical AI.
Backed by Hack VC, Nomad Capital, Pi Network, and other visionary investors, Axis Robotics bridges the data gap in Physical AI by delivering foundation model-ready datasets and sim-to-real pipelines that enable continuous, scalable policy improvement.

Kaito

Kaito (https://kaito.ai/) is the leading AI-powered intelligence platform, transforming how information is structured, shared, and valued across crypto, AI, stocks, and the wider frontier of tech and finance. Kaito powers a full stack of products, from its core intelligence platform (Kaito Pro, API & MCP) and creator marketplace (Kaito Studio) to its launchpad (Capital Launchpad), building new primitives for how influence and mindshare are measured, owned, and monetized.



## About Sponsors

Rocketpunch
Rocketpunch (https://www.rocketpunch.com/en) is a trusted business network built on verified identities.

Rocketpunch helps founders, investors, talent, and companies connect in a safer and more transparent way. Unlike open social networks where anyone can appear anonymously, Rocketpunch is designed around verified identities, enabling people and organizations to build trust and create real opportunities.

Rocketpunch is also evolving beyond a network for people and companies. It is becoming a platform where AI agents connected to real people and organizations can participate, act, and create opportunities. These agents can help users discover relevant people, jobs, investments, partnerships, and business opportunities within a trusted network.

name: Crypto Compliance and Legal Roundtable, hosted by Solidus Labs and Yulchon
description:
Crypto Compliance & Legal Roundtable | Seoul

Join us on September 29 during the Korea Blockchain Week in Seoul for an exclusive, invitation-only Crypto Compliance and Legal Roundtable, bringing together a selected group of compliance and legal leaders, regulators, and policy experts.

Hosted by Solidus Labs and Yulchon, this in-person session will focus on advancing global crypto compliance through practical discussion. The roundtable is designed to foster open dialogue, share best practices, and identify actionable solutions to today’s most pressing regulatory and compliance challenges.

Agenda

16:30 – Registration
17:00 – 18:30– Roundtable discussions: Best practices, challenges, and actionable solutions across key crypto compliance and legal topics, including:


• Tokenization and Implementation of the amended Capital Markets Act and Electronic Securities Act
  • How the recently enacted framework will be implemented in practice, including issuance, distribution and the treatment of investment contract securities.
    • Speaker:  Ik Hyun Kim, Partner at Yulchon leading the blockchain and digital assets practice
• Cross-border VASP compliance –
  • Korea’s planned extension of the Travel Rule to transfers below KRW 1 million
  • Growing regulatory focus on foreign and unregistered VASPs.
  • Stablecoins transfers and future challenges.
    • Speaker: Claire Lee, CEO of CODE
• Unfair Coin Trading Regulatory Frameworks in Korea
  • Overview of actual prosecution and referral cases over the past two years to examine the rankings of the most prevalent types of unfair trading practices and sheds light on the specific schemes and deceptive methods unique to the Korean virtual asset market
    • Speakers: Jackie Baek, Compliance Head of Korea at Crypto.com (https://Crypto.com)

18:30 – Networking

Address: Yulchon, Parnas Tower, 38F 521 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu Seoul Republic of Korea

Places are limited. Registration is subject to approval.

About Yulchon
Yulchon is a full-service law firm headquartered in Seoul, Korea, advising on a full range of specialized practice areas, including corporate & finance, antitrust, tax, real estate & construction, dispute resolution, intellectual property & technology, and labor & employment. The firm was established in 1997 and has about 700 professionals. In addition to our main offices in Seoul, Yulchon has six overseas offices across five jurisdictions and 10 regional practice teams worldwide. The firm provides the highest quality of legal services to its clients around the globe, including their most complex legal matters.  Yulchon's Blockchain/Virtual Assets Team consists of seasoned experts who bring a wealth of experience and exceptional knowledge to deliver the highest standard of legal services in Korea’s finance, blockchain, and virtual asset sectors.

About Solidus Labs

Born in crypto and built for efficiency across all asset classes, Solidus Labs is the category-definer for agentic-based compliance in trade surveillance and risk monitoring. At its core is HALO, an AI-powered, risk-based platform trusted globally by financial institutions, crypto firms, and regulators to enable proactive, intelligence-led oversight across any product, venue, or asset class.

[주최]


안암145_ANAM145

안암145는 고려대학교 정보보호대학원 연구진이 설립한 Web3 사이버보안 기업입니다. 커널 보안 기반 통합 지갑 '안암월렛(AnamWallet)'과 보안 단말기 '안암패드'를 중심으로, KYT 기반 이상거래 탐지와 DID 신원인증 등 Web3 디지털 금융 보안 인프라를 개발하고 있습니다. UNDP 글로벌 블록체인 혁신 프로그램에 선정되어 해외 공공 금융 인프라 실증을 수행하고 있으며, 중소벤처기업부 딥테크 TIPS 지원기업으로도 선정되었습니다. 공공·금융·산업 분야에서 안전한 Web3 보안 생태계를 만드는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.


• ANAM145 Homepage (https://anam145.io)

고려대 블록체인 밸리_Blockchain Valley

블록체인 밸리는 고려대학교 기반 블록체인 학회입니다. 2022년 3월 1기 출범을 시작으로 현재 50명의 학회원이 개발팀, 리서치팀, 보안팀, 코어팀으로 나뉘어 활동하고 있습니다. 프로덕트 제작, 리서치 페이퍼 발간, AML/CFT 리서치, 코어 리서치, 밸리데이터 운영을 중심으로 타 학회 연계 프로젝트, 기업 협력, 아이디어톤·해커톤 참여 등 활발한 활동을 이어가고 있습니다.


• Blockchain Valley X (https://x.com/blockchainkor?utm_source=luma)
• Blockchain Valley Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/blockchain__valley/?utm_source=luma)

[메인 파트너]


아이티센 피엔에스_ITCEN PNS

아이티센 피엔에스는 아이티센그룹의 보안 전문 기업으로, 양자내성암호(PQC), Web3 보안, AI 생체인증 등 첨단 보안 기술을 기반으로 고객의 디지털 혁신을 보호합니다. 2011년 설립 이후 클라우드·모바일·인프라 전반의 보안 컨설팅과 솔루션을 공급해 왔으며, PQC 기술을 적용한 보안 솔루션과 블록체인 지갑 솔루션을 선보이고 있습니다. 사명의 PNS는 플랫폼·보안·솔루션을 의미하며, 공공·금융 분야에서 축적한 그룹의 IT 서비스 역량을 바탕으로 안전한 디지털 금융 환경을 만들어가고 있습니다.


• ITCEN PNS Homepage (https://itcenpns.com/index.do)


Aomi Labs

Aomi Labs는 온체인 금융을 위한 Execution Harness를 개발하는 인프라 기업입니다. 사용자 요청을 트랜잭션으로 구성한 뒤 Live Chain State 기반 시뮬레이션과 정책 검증을 거쳐 사용자의 signer에게 전달하며, non-custodial·wallet-agnostic 런타임으로 온체인 프로토콜과 30개 이상의 오프체인 venue를 아우르는 공통 실행 레이어를 제공합니다.


• Aomi Labs Homepage (https://aomi.dev/)

[스폰서]

탄젬_Tangem

탄젬은 카드형·링형 콜드월렛으로 하드웨어 지갑의 새로운 기준을 제시하고 있는 글로벌 셀프 커스터디 지갑 기업입니다. 삼성 반도체와 협력해 개발한 EAL6+ 인증 보안 칩(Secure Element)에 개인키를 생성·저장해 키가 외부로 노출되지 않으며, 케이블이나 배터리 없이 NFC 탭 한 번으로 트랜잭션에 서명할 수 있습니다. 세계 최초의 링 형태 하드웨어 지갑 '탄젬 링(Tangem Ring)'을 비롯해 수천 종의 자산을 지원하는 지갑 제품군을 통해, 누구나 일상 속에서 안전하게 디지털 자산을 관리할 수 있는 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다.


• Tangem Homepage (https://tangem.com/ko/)

해시키_HashKey Chain

해시키 체인(HashKey Chain)은 홍콩 최대 규모의 제도권 암호화폐 거래소인 해시키(HashKey)가 개발한 컴플라이언스 친화적인 기관 수준 블록체인 인프라로, 글로벌 금융시장을 온체인 환경에서 새롭게 구축하는 것을 목표로 합니다. 컴플라이언스, 보안, 혁신을 핵심 가치로 하며, 스테이블코인, RWA, 기관용 DeFi가 유기적으로 연결되는 차세대 온체인 금융을 위한 기반 환경을 제공합니다.

해시키 체인은 거래소 서비스, 기관용 커스터디, 전통 금융기관과의 폭넓은 네트워크 등 해시키 그룹의 종합적인 디지털 자산 생태계를 활용할 수 있습니다.

또한 원활한 법정화폐 온·오프램프(Fiat On/Off-Ramp)를 지원하고, 규제를 준수하는 가상자산 서비스 네트워크와의 연결을 통해 기관의 온체인 금융시장 진입을 지원합니다.


• HSK Chain Homepage (https://www.hskchain.net/)

[네트워크 파트너]

써틱_CertiK

CertiK은 학술적 수준의 엄격한 기술 역량을 바탕으로 Web3 생태계가 직면한 다양한 보안 과제를 해결하는 글로벌 최대 Web3 보안 서비스 기업입니다. 블록체인 인프라 평가, 스마트 컨트랙트 보안 감사, 정형 검증(Formal Verification), 침투 테스트, 커스터디 아키텍처 검토, 시스템 성능 평가, 컴플라이언스 지원 등 디지털 자산의 전 생애주기를 아우르는 종합적인 리스크 관리 솔루션을 제공합니다.
현재까지 CertiK은 5,500개 이상의 기업 고객과 협력해 왔으며, 축적된 기술 전문성과 글로벌 경험을 바탕으로 여러 국가 및 지역의 디지털 자산 규제 체계 구축과 정책 발전에도 기여하고 있습니다.

## For International Builders & Foundations


## TRUST404 — Web3 Security Hackathon

Trust Not Found. Build It.

In Web3, you don't only lose assets when code breaks. You lose them the moment a user clicks "Confirm." One malicious signature, one disguised contract, and a wallet is drained — while all the user ever saw was an unreadable hex string.

TRUST404 is a hackathon for turning blockchain security ideas into working products. Across four technical tracks — smart contract threat detection, decentralized identity, off-chain decision provenance, and autonomous exploit proving — participants define their own problem and prove it with a build that actually runs.

Every participant is invited to TRUST404 CONNECT, held during Korea Blockchain Week 2026, where you'll meet representatives from global projects and foundations face to face. Winning teams and standout participants get the stage to present their projects directly.


## Event Overview


• Format: Online build period + offline demo day
• Online build: From registration until Sunday, September 20 (submission deadline)
• Demo day: Tuesday, September 29, 2026, 5:30 PM – 10:00 PM
• Venue: Dreamplus Gangnam (311 Gangnam-daero, Seocho-gu, Seoul)
• Who should join: Web3 developers, security researchers, smart contract engineers, frontend/infra developers, and students in related fields
• Team size: 1–5 members
• Entry fee: Free

## Technical Tracks

Pick a track, then define your own problem and approach within it. The expected outcomes below are examples — feel free to go beyond them.


1. Smart Contract Threat Detection
2. Decentralized Identity — DID & VC
3. Off-chain Decision Provenance
4. Autonomous Exploit Prover

For detailed track descriptions, check the hackathon website (https://trust404.co.kr/ ) and Discord (https://discord.com/invite/4WgxmmSba).

Hackathon Homepage: https://trust404.co.kr/

Discord invite: https://discord.com/invite/4WgxmmSba

Open Track

Examples: x402, agent payments, multichain

For the Open Track, you can build on the example ideas above — or bring any other Web3 security or application idea of your own.


## Judging Criteria


• Problem definition · 25% — Is it clear who faces this problem? Is it a real one?
• Security soundness · 25% — Is the threat model well-defined? Have you considered how it could be bypassed?
• Working implementation · 20% — Can it be demonstrated live?
• Verifiability · 15% — Have you proven the impact with numbers or scenarios?
• Scalability · 5% — Can this live on after the hackathon?
• Judge's discretionary points · 10%

We value working demos over slides. Please include a live demonstration in your presentation.

## Hosts

ANAM145

ANAM145 is a Web3 cybersecurity company founded by researchers from the Korea University Graduate School of Information Security. Built around AnamWallet, a kernel-security-based integrated wallet, and AnamPad, a secure terminal device, the company develops digital finance security infrastructure for Web3 — including KYT-based anomalous transaction detection and DID identity verification. ANAM145 was selected for the UNDP Global Blockchain Innovation Program, where it is running public financial infrastructure pilots overseas, and is also a Deep Tech TIPS company backed by Korea's Ministry of SMEs and Startups. Its mission is to build a safe Web3 security ecosystem across the public, financial, and industrial sectors.

Blockchain Valley (Korea University)

Blockchain Valley is a blockchain society based at Korea University. Since its first cohort launched in March 2022, it has grown to 50 members working across four teams: Development, Research, Security, and Core. Its activities span product building, research paper publication, AML/CFT research, core protocol research, and validator operations — alongside joint projects with other societies, corporate partnerships, and participation in ideathons and hackathons.


## Main Partner

ITCEN PNS

ITCEN PNS is the security specialist of the ITCEN Group, protecting its clients' digital innovation with advanced security technologies including post-quantum cryptography (PQC), Web3 security, and AI-powered biometric authentication. Founded in 2011, the company has delivered security consulting and solutions across cloud, mobile, and infrastructure, and now offers PQC-based security solutions and blockchain wallet solutions. Its name stands for Platform, Security, and Solution — and drawing on the group's IT service expertise in the public and financial sectors, ITCEN PNS is building a safe digital finance environment.

Aomi Labs

Aomi Labs is an infrastructure company developing an Execution Harness for on-chain finance. It composes transactions based on user requests, runs simulations against live chain state, and performs policy verification before passing them to the user's signer. Operating as a non-custodial, wallet-agnostic runtime, Aomi Labs provides a unified execution layer that bridges on-chain protocols and over 30 off-chain venues.


## Sponsors

Tangem

Tangem is a global self-custody wallet company redefining hardware wallets with its card- and ring-type cold wallets. Private keys are generated and stored on an EAL6+ certified secure element chip developed with Samsung Semiconductors — never leaving the device — and transactions are signed with a single NFC tap, no cables or batteries required. From the Tangem Ring, the world's first ring-shaped hardware wallet, to a wallet lineup supporting thousands of assets, Tangem is making secure digital asset management part of everyday life.

HashKey Chain

HashKey Chain is a compliance-friendly, institutional-grade blockchain infrastructure developed by HashKey, Hong Kong's largest licensed cryptocurrency exchange, with the goal of rebuilding global financial markets in an on-chain environment. With compliance, security, and innovation as its core values, it provides the foundation for next-generation on-chain finance where stablecoins, RWA, and institutional DeFi are organically connected.

HashKey Chain draws on the HashKey Group's comprehensive digital asset ecosystem, including exchange services, institutional custody, and an extensive network of traditional financial institutions. It also supports seamless fiat on/off-ramps and helps institutions enter the on-chain financial market through connections with regulation-compliant virtual asset service networks.


## Networking Partners

CertiK

CertiK is the world's largest Web3 security services company, tackling the full range of security challenges facing the Web3 ecosystem with academically rigorous technical expertise. Its comprehensive risk management solutions span the entire lifecycle of digital assets — including blockchain infrastructure assessment, smart contract security audits, formal verification, penetration testing, custody architecture review, system performance evaluation, and compliance support.
To date, CertiK has worked with more than 5,500 enterprise clients, and drawing on its accumulated technical expertise and global experience, it also contributes to the development of digital asset regulatory frameworks and policy across multiple countries and regions.

Lambda256

Lambda256, the blockchain arm of Dunamu, is a leading Web3 technology company driving innovation across infrastructure, data, and digital finance. With a proven track record supporting financial institutions, global partners, and large-scale Web3 applications, Lambda256 continues to shape the future of digital transformation with enterprise-grade blockchain solutions.

Zeta

ZetaChain is building this application layer for private AI, starting with Anuma. Anuma is a multi-model AI app where a single memory can be used across multiple AI models, and ownership of that memory remains with the user—currently used by over 300,000 people.

Four Pillars

Four Pillars is a research-driven Web3 solutions company bridging the gaps between Asia and the world, traditional and on-chain finance, and research and execution. Rather than stopping at reading information, Four Pillars covers the full journey — understanding, participating, and building — under one consistent standard.

CoinEasy

CoinEasy is an all-in-one crypto platform for Web3 education and community, built around the motto "Learn crypto the easy way." With accessible educational content, market insights, and an active community, CoinEasy helps Web2 users onboard smoothly into Web3 — while also serving as a bridge for global projects entering the Korean market. It has grown into one of Korea's leading platforms for bringing Web3 to a wider audience.

Berachain

Berachain is a high-performance, EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain built on Proof of Liquidity — a novel consensus mechanism that aligns the incentives of validators, applications, and users. Unlike traditional Proof of Stake, where assets sit locked away, Berachain ties network security to active liquidity provision, so the chain's security and its DeFi ecosystem grow together. The result is a blockchain designed to serve as a growth engine for on-chain businesses.

D'CENT

D'CENT is a blockchain wallet brand built by security experts with over a decade of experience in embedded security. Since launching the world's first biometric hardware wallet in 2018, D'CENT has grown into a global wallet service used across 220 countries. Its operator, IoTrust, also runs WEPIN, a B2B wallet infrastructure that helps partners enter the Web3 ecosystem quickly and easily. Built on Secure Element and Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) technology, D'CENT is creating Web3 infrastructure that makes managing digital assets safe and simple for everyone.

Quack AI

Quack AI is a unified execution and governance layer for AI agents, bundling proposal analysis, delegation, policy verification, and on-chain execution into a single stack — connecting DAO operations, agent-to-agent payments, treasury automation, and tokenized asset governance through one shared policy and execution pipeline.

BNB Chain

BNB Chain is one of the world's largest and most active blockchain ecosystems, supported by a global community of developers and users. With high throughput, low transaction costs, and full EVM compatibility, BNB Chain powers scalable applications across finance, gaming, and the broader Web3 economy.

Unibase

Unibase is a decentralized memory layer for AI agents. It aims to build the infrastructure that lets agents retain memory beyond a single session, collaborate with agents on other platforms, and evolve on their own.

UnitTX

Unit TX is a marketing studio focused on bringing global Web3 projects into the Korean market. For Unit TX, marketing is not about making things known — it's about making them understood. When a project crosses borders, what must travel with it is context: Unit TX reads the market through on-chain data, builds relationships through community, and translates a project's language into Korea's language through research and media.

ShortChall

ShortChall is a global participatory platform combining short-form content, challenges, rewards, and commerce. Beyond letting users create short-form content and take part in challenges and voting, it is building an ecosystem that extends into live commerce and content-driven commerce. ShortChall is currently building its Web3 services on GIWA, creating an onboarding structure that connects existing Web2 users into the Web3 ecosystem without complex entry barriers.

Dgrid AI

DGrid AI builds an open, transparent, community-driven decentralized AI network, giving developers and users low-cost, verifiable, trust-minimized access to a wide range of AI models and agents through an integrated smart marketplace and scheduling layer. With early traction including over $23M in revenue, 50K DAU / 500K MAU, and 15K+ subscribers, alongside research achievements such as PoQ and Optimistic TEE-Rollups, DGrid AI aims to build sustainable decentralized AI infrastructure.

Radius

Radius builds economic infrastructure for rollups and arbitrageurs, centered on open and shared value creation. Radius's Secure Block Building (SBB) and Lighthouse help rollups capture revenue efficiently and enable arbitrageurs to compete in blockspace auctions spanning CEXs, DEXs, and Ethereum's L1 and L2s.

DigitalAsset

DigitalAsset is a blockchain and virtual asset media outlet founded in October 2022, aiming to reduce information asymmetry in the fast-moving digital asset market by providing verified news, data, and research. Alongside timely coverage of price, regulation, and technology, it interprets on-chain metrics, charts, and macroeconomic trends, and provides the grounds for decision-making — from beginners to institutional and professional investors — through in-depth reports on projects, companies, and people (D'Asset Research), on-site coverage of seminars and forums (D'Asset On&Off), and VC investment trend analysis.

GWDC

GWDC (Global Web3 Dev Con) is a global Web3 developer conference connecting developers, companies, and investors. Hosted by Web3Labs and co-hosted by Techub News and others, its slogan is "For Builders, By Builders." Running a main conference and hackathon side by side, GWDC tackles real implementation challenges across AI×Web3, RWA, PayFi, account abstraction, and on-chain infrastructure.

Blockmedia

Blockmedia is one of Korea's leading Web3 media outlets, delivering content on digital assets and blockchain. Alongside a wide range of market information, it strives to provide readers with forward-looking insight from diverse perspectives spanning regulation, finance, economics, and technology.

Exilist

Exilist is a GTM partner supporting global projects' entry and growth in the Korean market, with a focus on on-chain finance and blockchain infrastructure. Drawing on its own research and local operating experience, it designs positioning and execution strategies, and drives user engagement and product adoption through Korean-language content, community, KOL campaigns, and media outreach. A senior team with exchange business development and global GTM/media experience leads everything from strategy to execution, having worked with over 50 global teams to date. Tokenized securities are currently its main research and business focus.


## Academy Partners

HYBLOCK (Hanyang University)

HYBLOCK brings together people who see blockchain as a transformative technology and want to become pioneers of its future. Aiming to grow professional talent for the blockchain industry, members work in either the business team or the development team based on the skills they want to build. HYBLOCK centers its activities on research into the blockchain industry and ecosystem, and runs the Telegram channel "Allround X HYBLOCK" to share insights with newcomers.

De-Butler (Kwangwoon University)

De-Butler is a community founded to make Web3 accessible to everyone. Beyond simply training more builders, De-Butler aims to help anyone interested in Web3 find a natural way into the ecosystem.

Aidenteti Crew

Founded in 2022, Aidenteti Crew is a Web3 offline academic and community group for current and aspiring builders. It aims to be a "builders' playground" — an open, flexible space where members freely pursue project development, hackathons, recruiting, and community activities.

SKKRYPTO (Sungkyunkwan University)

SKKRYPTO is the official blockchain society of Sungkyunkwan University, founded in 2018. With around 110 members since its founding, it brings together students from diverse majors to lower the barriers to blockchain technology and serves as a collaborative network that expands insight by combining broad perspectives.

Blue Node (Inha University)

Blue Node is a blockchain society founded at Inha University in 2023, with around 60 members based in Incheon. Going beyond study alone, Blue Node explores the fundamentals of blockchain technology and aims to make real contributions to the blockchain ecosystem.

CURG (Inter-university Society)

CURG is a blockchain alliance society founded in 2018 by universities across Seoul. A gathering of tech enthusiasts, CURG conducts blockchain research and proof-of-concept projects with a 3T mindset — Trendy, Thoughtful, Transdisciplinary — with the goal of accelerating blockchain adoption and contributing to ecosystem growth.

Gairos (Gachon University)

Gairos, the blockchain society of Gachon University, pursues innovative applications of blockchain and broader public access to the technology. It explores ways to understand blockchain's strengths deeply, spread them widely, and apply them in the real world — growing from the top society in Gyeonggi Province toward the global stage through active collaboration with industry and university players at home and abroad.

BAY (Yonsei University)

Blockchain at Yonsei (BAY), founded in 2017 as Korea's first blockchain society, aims to spread blockchain innovation and contribute to ecosystem growth. Across Web3, DeFi, NFTs, and blockchain infrastructure, members build deep technical understanding and hands-on experience through weekly sessions with industry experts, team-based development projects, hackathons, and research.

PDAO (POSTECH)

PDAO is a crypto and blockchain community based at POSTECH (Pohang University of Science and Technology). Open to anyone, PDAO serves as a space where people interested in the blockchain ecosystem can plan and join activities that let them freely contribute to the industry.

Decipher (Seoul National University)

Decipher, the blockchain society of Seoul National University, was founded in late 2017 with the mission of contributing to the healthy growth of the blockchain industry through technology development and value research. Through seminars, lectures, conferences, industry-academia research, and open-source contributions, Decipher works to build a healthy blockchain ecosystem. Having produced outstanding talent for both industry and academia, it has established itself as Korea's leading blockchain society — and aims to become an irreplaceable one worldwide.

Ewha-Chain (Ewha Womans University)

Ewha-Chain is a leading university blockchain community in Korea, connected with Google Cloud, Solana, BNB Chain, NEAR, Samsung Securities, Bithumb, KPMG, PwC, and more. Specializing in Web3 conferences, hackathons, and meetups, Ewha-Chain welcomes partnerships and ecosystem collaboration.

Orakle (KAIST)

Orakle is a Web3 builder community at KAIST united by the vision of "completing the mass adoption of blockchain." Each cohort spends a semester moving between research and building, proving itself through results. Orakle offers deep understanding to those new to blockchain — and a stage to shine for those who already know it.

blockblock (Yonsei University)

blockblock is a blockchain club at Yonsei University, founded in September 2022 as a gathering place for anyone who wants to study blockchain together. It strives to be an ecosystem where people interested in blockchain can grow and make a positive impact on the Web3 industry — run, true to the spirit of blockchain, by members from diverse departments bringing diverse perspectives.

Layer-A (Ajou University)

Layer-A is Ajou University's blockchain community, researching ways to contribute to the growth of the Web3 ecosystem — and opening doors for anyone who wants to take part in the blockchain and Web3 industry.

티오십사 랩스는 AI 에이전트 경제를 위한 신뢰 레이어를 구축합니다 — 기관과 애플리케이션이 AI 에이전트를 안심하고 활용할 수 있게 하는 리스크·언더라이팅 인프라입니다. 자금이 움직이기 전에 에이전트의 신원과 의도를 검증하고, 거래 및 거래상대방 리스크를 평가하며, 컴플라이언스와 책임소재를 위한 증거를 남깁니다. 나아가 에이전트 기반 금융 인프라를 통해 이러한 안전장치를 에이전트들이 실제로 거래하는 프로토콜과 금융 레일에 직접 내장함으로써, 신뢰 자체를 인프라의 일부로 만들고 있습니다.

T54 Labs is Building the Trust Layer for the Agentic Economy — The Risk and Underwriting Infrastructure that lets Institutions and Applications put AI Agents to Work with Confidence. Before money moves, T54 Verifies an Agent's Identity and Intent, Assesses Transaction and Counterparty Risk, and Preserves The Evidence needed for Compliance and Accountability. T54 is also Building Agentic Financial Infrastructure, bringing these same Safeguards directly into the Protocols and Financial Rails where Agents Transact — so Trust ㅠecomes part of the Infrastructure Itself.

오브스는 더욱 정교하고 효율적인 온체인 트레이딩을 위해 설계된 탈중앙형 레이어3(L3) 블록체인 인프라입니다. 분산된 유동성을 통합하고 고급 주문 기능과 탈중앙 파생상품 기술을 제공해, DeFi 트레이딩 경험을 한 단계 더 발전시킵니다.

Orbs is a Decentralized Layer3(L3) Blockchain Infrastructure Built to Power more Advanced and Efficient On-Chain Trading. By Aggregating Liquidity and Enabling Advanced Order Types and Decentralized Derivatives, Orbs takes the DeFi Trading Experience to the Next Level.

터보플로우는 무기한 선물과 이벤트 계약(Event Contracts)을 한 곳에서 거래할 수 있는 아시아·태평양(APAC) 중심의 온체인 트레이딩 플랫폼입니다. 최소 2달러로 참여해 빠르면 30초 만에 정산되는 이벤트 계약부터 최대 1,000배 레버리지의 무기한 선물까지, 강력한 시장 접근성을 누구나 쉽고 직관적으로 누릴 수 있도록 설계되었습니다. Pantera Capital, Susquehanna Crypto, DCG의 투자 유치를 한 터보플로우는 ‘누구나 시장에 참여할 수 있어야 한다’는 비전을 실현하고 있습니다.

Korea’s current administration is actively legislating a stablecoin framework, uniquely positioning Seoul at the intersection of global policy and institutional finance.

Held during Korea Blockchain Week (KBW) 2026, this summit bypasses retail marketing to focus exclusively on institutional adoption, operational readiness, and regulatory compliance.

It serves as the premier space where traditional financial organizations preparing for the stablecoin era connect directly with the global pioneers driving that transition forward.

• High-Caliber Networking: A dedicated executive networking lounge separate from the main conference hall, paired with a networking lunch.

• Institutions: Executive leaders from commercial banks, asset managers, securities firms, and fintechs with active digital asset mandates.

name: Where AI Meets RealFi at KBW 2026
description:
## Where AI Meets RealFi @ KBW 2026

Wednesday, September 30, 2026
3:00–7:00 PM
People The Terrace, Seoul

Vaults, tokenized yield, AI-native finance, and the builders shaping the next phase of onchain adoption.


Join Pharos during Korea Blockchain Week for Where AI Meets RealFi, the official launch event for the Pharos Vault Launchpad.

This focused afternoon summit brings together the people building institutional-grade onchain products with the investors, partners, and communities that can help them scale.

Expect stage conversations, live product demonstrations, ecosystem showcases, and curated networking centered on the convergence of RealFi, tokenized assets, sustainable yield, AI-native finance, and blockchain infrastructure.

Whether you are an investor, vault issuer, asset manager, AI builder, ecosystem founder, institutional partner, KOL, media representative, or member of Korea’s Web3 community, the event offers a high-value setting to discover new products, exchange ideas, and build lasting partnerships.

Expected attendance: 200–300 guests


## What to Expect

RealFi & Tokenized Yield

Explore products and strategies spanning consumer credit, fixed income, BTC strategies, real estate, and tokenized yield.

Pharos Vault Launchpad

Meet the vault issuers, asset managers, and curators creating the next generation of institutional-grade onchain investment products.

AI × Blockchain

Discover how AI agents can find, access, and coordinate financial activity across tokenized assets and yield sources.

Live Product Showcases

See demonstrations from vault issuers, applications, AI companies, infrastructure providers, and other projects building across the Pharos ecosystem.

Strategic Networking

Connect with investors, institutions, founders, ecosystem partners, Korean market leaders, KOLs, media, and communities.

VIP Lounge

A private second-floor space for invited founders, institutions, speakers, investors, and strategic partners to meet throughout the afternoon.


## Event Program

3:00–3:30 PM | Registration & Networking
Arrive, check in, and meet fellow attendees over refreshments.

3:30–3:40 PM | Opening Remarks from Pharos
Welcome remarks and an introduction to the Pharos ecosystem and Vault Launchpad.

3:40–4:20 PM | AI & Physical AI Demo Showcase
Live demonstrations from AI companies, agent builders, and physical AI startups exploring new applications at the intersection of AI and blockchain.

A dedicated spotlight featuring products and use cases from participating ecosystem partners.

5:30–7:00 PM | Networking, Live Demos & VIP Lounge
Continue conversations, explore product demonstrations, and connect with founders, investors, institutions, and ecosystem leaders.

The agenda is subject to final speaker and partner confirmation.


## Who You’ll Meet


• Venture funds and strategic investors
• Family offices and asset managers
• Institutional and financial partners
• Vault issuers and curators
• AI companies and agent developers
• Physical AI startups
• Infrastructure builders and product teams
• Pharos ecosystem projects
• Korean Web3 communities
• Founders, developers, and users
• KOLs and media


## About Pharos Network

Pharos is the inclusive financial Layer 1 for RealFi, where real value and institutional-grade assets circulate onchain and become composable with decentralized assets.

By bringing together scalable blockchain infrastructure, tokenized assets, sustainable yield, and AI-powered financial experiences, Pharos is building a more open and accessible foundation for global finance.

About TopNod  

TopNod is a decentralised, self-custodial wallet, focusing on digital versions of real-world assets (RWAs). TopNod allows users to manage their RWAs, major tokens and stablecoins by integrating services provided by popular third-party platforms. It provides users with a secure and intuitive tool to view, manage, and interact with RWAs and other digital assets — all in one application, designed to feel as familiar and easy to use as mainstream internet apps. For more information, please visit:  https://topnod.com/  

About R25  

R25 has built a standardized, modular Vault technical architecture for next-generation on-chain assets. Based on open standards such as ERC-4626, ERC-7540, and ERC-7575, R25 decouples asset custody, token issuance, asynchronous deposits and withdrawals, NAV calculation, position valuation, fee management, and trade execution into composable and upgradeable independent modules. Through pluggable asset adapters, it uniformly supports diverse assets including native crypto assets, yield-bearing Vaults, RWAs, perpetual contracts, and more. Compared with traditional single-asset Vaults, R25 is not only capable of handling complex multi-asset portfolios and non-real-time settlement scenarios, but also features DeFi composability, transparency, and cross-EVM network extensibility, providing a unified technical foundation for on-chain issuance, management, and distribution of global assets.    

About Zan 

ZAN is a reliable Web3 and AI brand under Ant Digital Technologies, dedicated to enabling business innovation with secure, scalable, and high-performance infrastructure services.

With a dual-track product strategy across Web3 and AI, ZAN provides foundational infrastructure for developers and enterprises building next-generation digital applications. On the Web3 side, ZAN offers ZAN Node Service and ZAN ZK Acceleration to support blockchain access, scalability, and zero-knowledge computing. On the AI side, ZAN provides ZAN Router to help enterprises route, monitor, and scale AI integrations.

About Anvita 

Anvita is dedicated to building the infrastructure for the next generation of the digital economy by integrating Web3 and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology.Our mission is to empower individuals and institutions to transform their unique knowledge, assets, and capabilities into sustainable digital systems, enabling more secure and efficient collaboration and commercial activities on a global scale. We believe the future economic system is moving towards a new era of the Autonomous Economy, driven by Autonomous Agents, Programmable Assets, and Trusted Collaboration Networks.By (http://Networks.By) combining the intelligence of AI with Web3 blockchain financial infrastructure, Anvita is building the infrastructure for the new digital economy paradigm.This allows individuals and institutions to better achieve real value creation and exchange, truly owning, managing, and unleashing the value of their digital capabilities and assets (Unleashing the Value in TokenS).

[About Animoca Brands (https://www.animocabrands.com/?utm_source=luma)]
Animoca Brands is a global digital assets leader building and investing in impactful technologies and ecosystems to reimagine future economies through AI and the agentic web. It is is recognized for building digital asset platforms such as the Moca Network, Open Campus, Anichess, and The Sandbox, as well as institutional-grade platforms; providing digital asset services to help Web3 companies launch and grow; and investing in frontier Web3 technology, with a portfolio of over 600 companies and digital assets.

[About Minds by Animoca Brands]
‍Minds by Animoca Brands is a persistent AI agent platform that removes complexity while preserving full control and customization for both builders and general users. It enables anyone to deploy and direct sovereign, always-on AI agents, called Minds, without having to operate local servers or manage any hardware or software. [About AIR]
AIR provides infrastructure for decentralized identity, money and loyalty. Through one integration stack, businesses can use AIR Identity to acquire and verify users through selective disclosure, sharing only the attributes each check requires; AIR Money to integrate payments, payouts, and settlement; and AIR Loyalty to run programmable rewards with points that settle at a fixed rate. AIR extends the same model to AI agents, granting scoped, verifiable authority to act for users and businesses. AIR is built by Moca Network, the identity network of Animoca Brands.


## AI부터 먹거리까지, 즐길 거리 가득한 KBW 마켓

9월 30일, 강남 Big Place에서 THE NEXT AI & Payment CARNIVAL이 열립니다. Animoca Brands의 Minds, MOCA NETWORK, 그리고 LINE NEXT의 Unifi가 함께 준비한 이번 행사는 AI 에이전트 체험과 디지털 결제에 놀이와 먹거리를 더한 KBW 사이드 이벤트입니다.

체크인 후 F&B 부스와 인형뽑기·룰렛을 즐겨보세요. Unifi 현장 결제와 자유로운 네트워킹도 시작됩니다.

오후 6시 — 경품 추첨

[Animoca Brands 소개]

Animoca Brands는 AI와 에이전틱 웹(agentic web)을 통해 미래 경제를 재구상하며, 영향력 있는 기술과 생태계를 구축하고 투자하는 글로벌 디지털 자산 선도 기업입니다. Moca Network, Open Campus, Anichess, The Sandbox와 같은 디지털 자산 플랫폼 및 기관급 플랫폼 구축으로 널리 알려져 있습니다. 또한 Web3 기업의 출범과 성장을 돕는 디지털 자산 서비스를 제공하며, 600개 이상의 기업 및 디지털 자산 포트폴리오를 바탕으로 차세대 Web3 기술에 투자하고 있습니다.

[Minds by Animoca Brands 소개]

Minds by Animoca Brands는 개발자와 일반 사용자 모두에게 완전한 제어권과 맞춤 설정 기능을 제공하면서도 복잡성을 제거한 영구형 AI 에이전트 플랫폼입니다. 로컬 서버를 가동하거나 별도의 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어를 관리할 필요 없이, 누구나 'Minds'라고 불리는 지속적으로 작동하는 주권적 AI 에이전트를 배포하고 지시할 수 있습니다. 자세한 내용은 hellominds.ai (https://hellominds.ai)에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

[AIR 소개]

AIR는 탈중앙화된 신원(Identity), 금융(Money), 로열티(Loyalty)를 위한 인프라를 제공합니다. 기업은 단 하나의 통합 스택을 통해 다음 기능들을 활용할 수 있습니다.


• AIR Identity: 각 검증에 필요한 속성만 선택적으로 공개하여 사용자를 확보하고 검증
• AIR Money: 결제, 정산 및 지급 기능 통합
• AIR Loyalty: 고정 환율로 정산되는 포인트를 활용한 프로그래밍 가능 리워드 운영

AIR는 동일한 모델을 AI 에이전트로 확장하여, 사용자 및 기업을 대리해 행동할 수 있는 범위 지정 및 검증 가능한 권한을 부여합니다. AIR는 Animoca Brands의 신원 네트워크인 Moca Network에 의해 개발되었습니다.

Token sales in 2026 work differently from previous cycles. Most capital is now raised in private rounds before any public allocation opens, and the public sale has become a distribution and community event rather than the main fundraise. 

In this invite-only session, our TokenMinds expert team will share practical strategies for this new environment.

• Token Sale setup for 2026, including round structure (private to public route), tokenomics, whitepaper, legal framework and more
• Choosing, and getting selected for, the right launchpads and platforms under today's stricter vetting and compliance
• Token Sale marketing strategies for a more selective market
• Post-TGE liquidity, listings & market engagement


## Why now

Token sale has become more selective now. Exchanges, launchpads and regulators ask sharper questions about sale terms, token rights and unlock schedules, and retail buyers do the same. This session helps you finalize a launch plan that holds up under that scrutiny before the year-end window closes.

## Stellar Night Seoul ✨

## 글로벌 RWA와 XLMFi의 현재를 서울에서 만나보세요

DCENT와 Stellar Development Foundation이 공동 주관하는 Stellar Night Seoul에 여러분을 초대합니다.

글로벌 금융기관들이 Stellar를 활용해 실물자산을 토큰화하는 흐름부터, XLM을 온체인에서 활용하는 XLMFi 생태계까지 한자리에서 만나보세요.

그동안 국내에서 쉽게 만날 수 없었던 Stellar 생태계가 DCENT와 함께 대중 앞에 처음으로 문을 엽니다. 글로벌 RWA와 XLMFi의 최전선을 직접 경험해 보세요.


## 📅 행사 정보


• 일시: 2026년 9월 30일(수) 오후 5시~9시

## 🌐 이번 행사에서 만나볼 이야기

글로벌 RWA와 기관의 온체인 진입
Stellar 팀과 금융·Web3 업계 관계자들이 글로벌 RWA 및 토큰화 시장의 현황과 한국 시장의 가능성을 이야기합니다.

XLMFi의 새로운 흐름
Sentora Vault와 Upshift Vault를 비롯해, XLM을 보유하는 것을 넘어 온체인에서 활용하는 XLMFi 생태계를 살펴봅니다.

## 🤝 이런 분들께 추천합니다

• Stellar 생태계와 협업 기회를 찾는 Web3 프로젝트
• XLMFi와 온체인 금융에 관심 있는 XLM 홀더
• Stellar 팀을 직접 만나 생태계의 방향을 듣고 싶은 분


## About Stellar Development Foundation

Stellar Development Foundation은 글로벌 결제와 RWA 토큰화를 지원하는 오픈소스 블록체인 네트워크 Stellar의 성장과 발전을 이끄는 비영리 조직입니다.

현재 Stellar에서는 10곳 이상의 규제 기반 발행사가 67종 이상의 토큰화 상품을 운영하고 있으며, 관련 자산 규모는 약 14억 달러에 달합니다. 이 가운데 11억 달러 이상이 국채, MMF, 원자재 등 실물자산과 연결되어 있습니다.


## About DCENT

DCENT는 국내 유일의 하드웨어 월렛 브랜드이자, 세계 최초의 생체인증 하드웨어 월렛을 선보인 글로벌 디지털자산 월렛 기업입니다. 또한 XLMFi를 최초로 지원한 하드웨어 월렛으로서 Stellar 생태계의 안전한 온체인 활용을 지원하고 있습니다.

현재 100개 이상의 블록체인 네트워크와 10,000개 이상의 토큰을 지원하며, 전 세계 220개국에서 100만 명 이상의 사용자에게 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.

제품 라인업으로는 DCENT Biometric Wallet, DCENT S, DCENT X를 갖추고 있으며, 개인용 월렛뿐만 아니라 기관의 디지털자산을 안전하게 관리할 수 있는 DCENT Enterprise 서비스도 제공합니다.

글로벌 RWA와 XLMFi의 현재, 그리고 Stellar 생태계의 다음 변화를 서울에서 만나보세요.

Stellar Night Seoul에서 여러분을 기다립니다! ✨


## Stellar Night Seoul ✨


## Discover the Latest in Global RWA and XLMFi in Seoul

Join Stellar Night Seoul, co-hosted by DCENT and the Stellar Development Foundation.

Discover how global financial institutions are using Stellar to tokenize real-world assets and explore the growing XLMFi ecosystem bringing new on-chain utility to XLM.

The Stellar ecosystem, which has rarely been accessible to the public in Korea, is opening its doors for the first time together with D’CENT. Experience the forefront of global RWA and XLMFi firsthand.

Explore Sentora Vault, Upshift Vault, and the growing XLMFi ecosystem enabling new ways to put XLM to work on-chain.

## About the Stellar Development Foundation

The Stellar Development Foundation is a nonprofit organization supporting the growth and development of Stellar, an open-source blockchain network built for global payments and real-world asset tokenization.

Stellar currently supports more than 67 tokenized products from over 10 regulated issuers, representing approximately $1.4 billion in assets. More than $1.1 billion is connected to real-world assets such as government bonds, money market funds, and commodities.


## About DCENT

DCENT is Korea’s only hardware wallet brand and the global digital asset wallet company behind the world’s first biometric hardware wallet. It is also the first hardware wallet to support XLMFi, enabling secure access to on-chain opportunities across the Stellar ecosystem.

DCENT supports more than 100 blockchain networks and 10,000 tokens, serving over one million users across 220 countries worldwide.

Its hardware wallet lineup includes the DCENT Biometric Wallet, DCENT S, and DCENT X. In addition to its consumer wallet products, DCENT also provides DCENT Enterprise services for the secure management of institutional digital assets.

Discover the latest in global RWA and XLMFi and experience what’s next for the Stellar ecosystem in Seoul.

🔭 A Curated Environment for Capital & Protocol Alignment

Proof of Liquidity is the dedicated venue for institutional deal flow during EthCC. Following oversubscribed editions in Singapore, Abu Dhabi, and Cannes, we return to Seoul for the 2026 edition. Across 2025–2026: over 10,000 registrations.

No panels. No stages. 

Just a strictly curated floor for the supply side (Allocators, Treasuries) and the demand side (L2s, RWAs, Protocols) to structure liquidity.

👥 Who Should Attend

Three types of people, one room:


• Capital - funds, market makers, family offices, DAO & corporate treasuries
• Yield - RWA issuers (private credit, T-Bills), top DeFi protocols, L1/L2s, lending markets
• Rails - vault infra providers, neobanks, wallets, custodians, bridges, oracles.

🧭 What to Expect


• Strict Curation - capped at 200. Decision-makers only.
• The Convergence - Capital (LPs, treasuries) + Product (DeFi, RWAs) + Distribution (neobanks, wallets, bridges), rails connecting both sides.
• Golden Hour Deal Flow - structured for introductions during the sunset window.
• Zero Noise - just the liquidity layer of the industry in one room.

🤝 Why It Matters

As DeFi matures into its next capital cycle, alignment between infrastructure, liquidity, and strategy becomes critical. Proof Of Liquidity exists to create the environment where that alignment can happen - naturally and effectively.

Hosted By:

Yield Network (https://www.yieldnetwork.io) is the capital formation and distribution firm for onchain markets.

We sit between institutional capital and onchain yield: we structure the products and raise the capital that fills them. Clients range from L1/L2 chains and DeFi protocols to digital asset managers and issuers of tokenized yield products.

What we run:

Pre-deposit and launch campaigns - capped, time-limited raises run end to end on our platform, from soft commitment through deposit and reporting

Lending programs - market design, curator coordination, and anchor capital for onchain lending markets

Liquidity strategy - program design, LP validation, infrastructure coordination, and launch execution for teams building a liquidity program from the ground up

Embedded yield - onchain yield integrated into fintechs, wallets, and consumer platforms that want yield products without building the stack themselves

LP dealflow - vetted deals with clear terms, capacity, and timelines for the capital side

Co-Hosted By:

The Monad Foundation (https://www.monad.xyz) is an independent organization dedicated to encouraging the development and adoption of the Monad blockchain protocol, an ultra-high-performant EVM L1 blockchain. Monad will offer the best of both worlds: unrivaled performance (10,000 transactions per second) and portability (full-compatibility for Ethereum smart contracts).

Shift (https://shiftdefi.com/) is a non-custodial DeFi platform bringing institutional discipline to on-chain investing. Through structured portfolio construction, continuous risk monitoring, and transparent execution, Shift simplifies access to DeFi yield.

​Frankencoin (https://frankencoin.com) (ZCHF) is the largest Swiss franc stablecoin: a decentralized, collateral-backed currency pegged to the CHF and governed entirely on-chain. Built for those who believe the Swiss franc is the world's best store of value, ZCHF brings Swiss monetary stability to DeFi across Ethereum and beyond.

Apyx (https://apyx.fi) is a next-generation yield platform offering users access to tokenized, income-generating assets, such as digital credit issued by Strategy and US Treasury bills.

name: [Altus x Decipher] Career Meet-up: The First Penguin
description:
## ✨이벤트 소개

디지털자산 인프라 기업 Altus(구 B-Harvest)와 서울대학교 블록체인 학회 Decipher가 2026 KBW 기간에 함께 개최하는 커리어 밋업 행사, The First Penguin입니다.

블록체인은 Web3의 실험적 단계를 넘어, 이제는 전통 금융 인프라를 교체하는 단계로 본격 진입하고 있습니다. Altus와 Decipher 역시 이러한 변화 속에서, 금융기관이 디지털자산과 블록체인 기술을 실제 비즈니스와 인프라에 적용하는 영역에 집중하고 있습니다.

The First Penguin은 무리에서 가장 먼저 바다에 뛰어드는 첫 번째 펭귄처럼, 이러한 변화의 흐름에 먼저 뛰어들 분들을 위한 자리입니다.

금융권 현직 실무자들과 함께 금융기관의 블록체인 도입과 변화를 살펴보고, Altus 현직자들의 실제 업무와 Decipher 학회원들의 커리어 경험을 들어볼 수 있습니다. 행사 후반에는 Altus의 직무 소개와 지원 안내가 이어집니다.


## 💙어떤 분들을 위한 자리일까요?


• 디지털자산 인프라에 관심이 있으신 분
  금융기관이 블록체인을 실제로 어떻게 검토하고 도입하는지 현직자의 목소리로 확인하실 수 있습니다.
• 능동적으로 커리어를 도약시키고 싶은 분
  금융과 블록체인이 만나는 영역에서 어떤 직무와 기회가 만들어지고 있는지 확인할 수 있습니다.
• 금융,핀테크 등 기존 산업에서 디지털자산 분야로 커리어 전환을 희망하시는 분
  주니어부터 시니어까지, 먼저 해당 커리어를 쌓고 있는 현직자의 경험을 들으실 수 있습니다.
• Altus와 Decipher에 관심이 있으신 분
  어떤 일을 하고 어떤 사람들과 함께하고자 하는지 알아가실 수 있습니다.


## 📌시간 및 장소


• 일시: 2026년 9월 30일 수요일 | 18:00 - 22:00
• 장소: 서울 (정확한 위치는 승인 후 공개됩니다)
• 인원: 최대 100명


## 🎙️진행 세션

모든 세션은 한국어로 진행됩니다.


• 참가자 등록 및 아이스브레이킹 (1시간 | 18:00 - 19:00)
• Decipher 소개 | Decipher 학회장 이영제 (5분 | 19:00 - 19:05)
• 오프닝 키노트 | Altus 대표 이형연 (5분 | 19:05 - 19:10)
• Altus 패널 토크 | 금융권 블록체인, 검토에서 도입으로 (40분 | 19:10 - 19:50 | 한국은행, KODA, 미래에셋 등 현직자가 패널로 참여)
• Decipher 패널 토크 | 주니어들이 들려주는 블록체인 커리어 이야기 (20분 | 19:50 - 20:10)
• Decipher 학회 우수팀 발표 | 토큰화증권 구멍가게 (10분 | 20:10 - 20:20)
• Altus 소개 | 회사, 직무, 그리고 지원 안내 (40분 | 20:20 - 21:00)
• 자유 네트워킹 (1시간 | 21:00 - 22:00)


## About Altus

Altus(구 B-Harvest)는 2018년 설립된 블록체인 금융 인프라 개발사입니다. 지난 8년간 국내외 금융기관과 블록체인 프로젝트를 위한 네트워크, 코어 프로토콜, 결제 및 RWA 토큰화 인프라를 구축해 왔습니다.

Altus의 미션은 기관의 디지털 자산 전략을 실제 운영 가능한 금융 시스템과 사업으로 구현하는 것입니다. 이를 위해 FDE(Forward-Deployed Engineer) 방식으로 고객 조직과 긴밀하게 협력하며, 문제 정의와 기술 전략 수립부터 아키텍처 설계, 코어 프로토콜 개발, 인프라 구축과 운영까지 전 과정을 수행합니다.

Altus는 일회성 시스템 구축을 넘어, 기관이 핵심 인프라를 직접 통제하고 지속적으로 운영·확장할 수 있는 기반을 만드는 것을 목표로 합니다.


## About Decipher

Decipher는 2017년 말에 서울대학교 블록체인 학회로 조직되었으며, 현재까지 약 160명 이상의 학회원들을 배출하였습니다. 저희는 ‘기술 개발과 가치 연구를 통해 블록체인 산업의 건전한 성장에 기여한다’는 미션 하에 세미나 및 특강 진행, 컨퍼런스 개최, 산학 협력 연구, 논문 연구, 오픈소스 기여, 보고서 발간 등 건강한 블록체인 생태계 조성에 기여하고 있습니다. 

현재 블록체인 업계와 학계에 뛰어난 인재들을 배출하며 국내 최고 블록체인 학회로서 자리매김하였으며, 세계적으로 대체 불가능한 학회를 목표하고 있습니다.


## 💌 공식 채널

  Website (https://altuslabs.io/), LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/altuslabs-hq/), X (https://x.com/AltusLabsHQ)


• Decipher
  Website (https://decipher.ac/ko), LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/decipher-ac/), X (https://x.com/DecipherGlobal)

name: RealFi x Asia Stablecoin Conference
description:
Title Sponsor: Top Node, S&P Global

Co-Hosts: Pharos Network, Four Pillars, LayerZero

Organizer: Asia Stablecoin Alliance, The Capital Summit


## Understand the Diverse Asia

Asia is not a single market.

Korea, Japan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Southeast Asia, the UAE, and other markets are each developing their own approach to stablecoins, tokenization, digital money, and financial infrastructure. These approaches are shaped by different regulations, institutions, currencies, payment needs, and capital market structures.

That’s why ASA Conference 2026 is returning to Seoul on October 1, 2026 to bring these conversations into one dedicated forum!

In 2025, ASA Conference brought together 700+ builders, issuers, institutions, infrastructure providers, researchers, and policymakers in Seoul. Across 17 sessions, teams including LayerZero, Ethena, Wyoming Stable Token, Canton, Securitize, and Plume explored how Asian stablecoins could move from concept to adoption.

This year’s conference goes deeper by moving from the big picture to the market level. ASA Conference 2026 will look at each market on its own terms, examining the issuers, distributors, institutions, use cases, and infrastructure shaping how new forms of money move across Asia.

The program will explore key topics including:


• Stablecoin issuance and distribution
• Local currency stablecoins
• Tokenized deposits and CBDCs
• Tokenization and real-world assets
• Cross-border payments and settlement
• Institutional adoption
• Regulation, compliance, and market infrastructure
• The role of banks, fintechs, payment firms, asset managers, issuers, and policymakers in shaping Asia’s digital money future

If you are building, investing, regulating, researching, or operating in stablecoins, tokenization, payments, or digital financial infrastructure across Asia, ASA Conference 2026 is designed for you.

Join us in Seoul on October 1, 2026.

Understand the Diverse Asia.


## About The Capital Summit

The Capital Summit is a curated institutional forum focused on how capital markets move onchain. It brings together investors, asset managers, banks, family offices, and infrastructure builders working at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets.

The summit exists to connect institutional capital with the people building onchain financial infrastructure — not as a trade show, but as a focused forum where allocators, operators, and builders meet across Asia and beyond.

Website (https://thecapitalsummit.ai/) | X (https://x.com/CapSummitGlobal) | LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/the-capital-summit) | YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/@The_Capital_Summit)


## About Asia Stablecoin Alliance

The Asia Stablecoin Alliance (ASA) is an initiative to accelerate stablecoin adoption across Asia. ASA connects builders, institutions, regulators, researchers, and ecosystem participants working on stablecoin infrastructure, compliance, distribution, and real-world use cases.

The alliance exists to give Asia its own voice, perspective, and coordination in stablecoin innovation. It is not a top down authority, but a network of people working together to move the ecosystem forward.

금융기관 60% · 기업 및 기관 20% · 글로벌 디지털자산 기업 10% · 정책 및 미디어 10%

description:
## EASYCON SEOUL 🇰🇷

배우고, 먹고, 오래 연결되는 밤.

차트 밖에서 움직이는 관심, 대화, 내러티브도 시장을 이해하는 중요한 맥락이 될 수 있습니다.

EASYCON SEOUL은 Suzanne Pace, Institutional Director at Santiment와 함께 온체인·소셜 인텔리전스를 실제 리서치에 어떻게 활용할 수 있는지 살펴보고, 맛있는 음식과 편안한 대화로 이어지는 커뮤니티 나이트입니다.

복잡한 컨퍼런스보다 한 테이블에 앉아 배우고 이야기하는 저녁에 가깝습니다. 처음 오시는 분도, 혼자 오시는 분도 편하게 함께해 주세요.

워크숍은 영어로 진행되며, 현장 체크인·안내와 Q&A에는 한국어 지원이 제공됩니다.

Beyond Price: The On-Chain and Social Metrics That Actually Drive Alpha in Digital Asset Markets

가격 너머의 온체인·소셜 데이터는 무엇을 보여주고, 무엇은 보여주지 못할까요?

짧고 집중도 높은 워크숍과 오픈 Q&A를 통해 온체인 활동, 시장의 관심 흐름, 내러티브와 커뮤니티 신호를 함께 읽는 방법을 살펴봅니다.

Suzanne Pace Institutional Director, Santiment

• 빠른 Luma 현장 체크인과 선택형 Telegram 커뮤니티 참여 안내


## MEET THE EASYBOY FRENS

20:15 Community Tables · Open Conversations

21:30 Event Ends

신논현역과 강남역 사이에 있는 편안한 카페형 라운지입니다. 주차가 어려우므로 대중교통 이용을 권장드립니다.

Save or share your Passport and revisit your attendance history at future EASYCON events. No wallet is required. Participation is optional; XP is not cash or a guaranteed USDC reward.


EASYCON COMMUNITY

## ENGLISH SUMMARY

Market signals do not live only in price charts. They also appear in on-chain activity and in what people notice, discuss, and believe.

Join Suzanne Pace, Institutional Director at Santiment, for Beyond Price: The On-Chain and Social Metrics That Actually Drive Alpha in Digital Asset Markets—a practical session on using on-chain and social intelligence as context for market research. The workshop is followed by warm food, drinks, and enough time for real conversations.

Come for the workshop. Stay for the people.

The workshop will be delivered in English, with Korean on-site guidance and Q&A support available.

당신의 최애 perpDEX는 어디인가요? 오늘 밤, 직접 응원하고 함께 겨뤄보세요.

오늘 밤 만나볼 팀들


## ​스탠드엑스(StandX) (https://standx.com/?utm_source=luma)

스탠드엑스는 BNB Chain과 Solana에서 자본 효율적인 무기한 선물 시장을 제공하는 온체인 트레이딩 플랫폼입니다. 증거금으로 활용하는 동안에도 수익이 쌓이는 DUSD를 기반으로, 거래 중에도 자본이 계속 생산적으로 운용되는 ‘Universal Markets & Universal Yield’를 구축하고 있습니다.

StandX is an On-Chain Trading Platform bringing Capital-Efficient Perpetual Markets to BNB Chain and Solana. Powered by DUSD—a Margin Asset that continues Earning Yield while used for Trading—StandX is Building Universal Markets and Universal Yield, Keeping Capital Productive even while Traders Remain in the Market.
Official Channel on X (https://x.com/StandX_Official)



## ​라이즈엑스(RISEx) (https://www.rise.trade/ko/trade/BTC?utm_source=luma)

라이즈엑스는 초고속 EVM Layer 2인 RISE를 기반으로 구축된, 빠르게 성장하는 완전 온체인 무기한 선물 거래소(Perp DEX)​입니다. CEX급 속도와 체결 성능에 높은 자본 효율성, 실시간 결제, 투명한 유동성을 결합해 성능과 탈중앙화 어느 쪽도 타협하지 않는 고성능 온체인 트레이딩 경험을 제공합니다.

RISEx is one of the Fastest-Growing Fully On-Chain Perpetual Exchanges, built on RISE, the fastest EVM Layer 2. Combining CEX-Grade Speed and Execution with Deep Capital Efficiency, Real-Time Settlement, and Transparent Liquidity, RISEx delivers a High-Performance Trading Experience—Fully On-Chain, without Compromise.
Official Channel on X (https://x.com/risextrade?s=20)



## 터보플로우(TurboFlow) (https://www.turboflow.xyz/?utm_source=luma)

터보플로우는 무기한 선물과 이벤트 계약(Event Contracts)을 한 곳에서 거래할 수 있는 아시아·태평양(APAC) 중심의 온체인 트레이딩 플랫폼입니다. 최소 2달러로 참여해 빠르면 30초 만에 정산되는 이벤트 계약부터 최대 1,000배 레버리지의 무기한 선물까지, 강력한 시장 접근성을 누구나 쉽고 직관적으로 누릴 수 있도록 설계되었습니다. Pantera Capital, Susquehanna Crypto, DCG의 투자 유치를 한 터보플로우는 ‘누구나 시장에 참여할 수 있어야 한다’는 비전을 실현하고 있습니다.

TurboFlow is an APAC-First On-Chain Trading Platform bringing Perpetuals and Event Contracts Together in One Seamless Venue. From $2 Event Contracts that Settle in as little as 30 seconds to Perpetuals with up to 1,000x Leverage, it makes Powerful Market Access Simple for Everyday Traders. Backed by Pantera Capital, Susquehanna Crypto, and DCG, TurboFlow is Built On a Simple Belief : Everyone Gets a Seat.
Official Channel on X (https://x.com/TurboFlow_xyz?s=20)


오늘 밤, 무슨 일이 벌어지나요?

행사는 패널토크 → 거래 대회 2라운드 → 네트워킹, 이렇게 진행돼요.

1️⃣ 패널토크
RISEx, StandX, TurboFlow 세 팀이 각자 프로젝트를 소개하고, 자유로운 패널 토론을 나눕니다.

2️⃣ RISEx × StandX 거래대회
등록하신 분들 중 원하는 분은 직접 무대에 올라가 RISEx 또는 StandX의 KOL과 1:1 실시간 트레이딩 대결을 펼칠 수 있어요. KOL 대 현장 유저, 누가 더 좋은 트레이딩을 보여줄지 실시간 화면과 리더보드로 지켜보세요.
대결이 끝나면 바로 시상 코너가 이어져요 — 라운드 중 나온 기록(최고 수익률, 인상적인 트레이딩 순간 등)을 짚어드립니다.

3️⃣ TurboFlow 거래대회
TurboFlow의 시그니처 상품, Event Contract로 진행되는 초스피드 대결이에요. 30초~1분 단위로 빠르게 진행되는 라운드에서, 현장 유저가 TurboFlow KOL과 맞붙습니다.
역시 대결 직후 시상 코너가 이어져요.

4️⃣ 자유 네트워킹
행사 막바지, 전체 등록 참여자 대상 온사이트 경품 추첨(래플)이 진행됩니다. 무대에 올라가지 않으셔도 참여만 하시면 추첨 대상이에요.

*행사 참여자에게는 StandX, RISEx, TurboFlow의 특별 혜택이 제공될 수 있습니다.

name: Liquidity Table by Turtle with Compound
description:
🇬🇧 A private dinner for the people shaping liquidity in Korea.

On KBW's second night, we're gathering a small, curated group of LPs, family offices, and funds around one table. A full course dinner in a private room, and conversation that wouldn't happen on a conference floor.

Hosted at the table by Essi Lagevardi, (https://x.com/SuperChad15) CEO of Turtle, (https://x.com/turtledotxyz) with partners from Compound Foundation. (https://x.com/Compound_xyz)

Date: Thursday, 1 October 2026
Time: 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM
Venue: Private dining room, Gangnam - details shared upon confirmation
Format: Full course menu, full service

Hosted by: Turtle (https://x.com/turtledotxyz) & Lunar Strategy (https://x.com/LunarStrategy)
Co-host: Compound Foundation (https://x.com/Compound_xyz)


## The evening

6:30 PM - Arrival and welcome drinks

7:00 PM - Welcome toast, first course served

8:30 PM - Evening closes


## Your hosts

Turtle is a liquidity distribution protocol connecting asset issuers to a verified network of 432,000+ on-chain LPs through a unified platform that handles deal sourcing, due diligence, incentive distribution, billing, and LP relationship management, all verifiable on chain.

Lunar Strategy, part of Turtle Group, is the crypto growth agency behind 400+ projects since 2019 - from token launches to ecosystem campaigns.

Compound is one of DeFi's foundational lending protocols - pioneering on-chain money markets and now stewarding the ecosystem through the Compound Foundation.

Twenty seats, each one curated. Apply below and we'll confirm yours.

🇰🇷 한국의 유동성 시장을 만들어가는 사람들을 위해 준비된 프라이빗 디너.

KBW 둘째 날 저녁, 소수의 엄선된 LP, 패밀리 오피스, 펀드 관계자들이 한 테이블에 모입니다. 프라이빗 룸에서 풀코스 디너를 즐기며, 컨퍼런스 현장에서는 쉽게 나누기 어려운 깊이 있는 대화를 나누는 자리입니다.

Turtle의 CEO인 Essi Lagevardi가 Compound Foundation의 파트너들과 함께 테이블을 호스트합니다.

날짜: 2026년 10월 1일 목요일
시간: 오후 6:30 ~ 8:30
장소: 강남 프라이빗 다이닝룸 - 참석 확정 후 상세 장소 안내
형식: 풀코스 메뉴, 풀서비스
주최: Turtle & Lunar Strategy
공동 주최: Compound Foundation


## 저녁 일정


• 오후 6:30 - 도착 및 웰컴 드링크
• 오후 7:00 - 웰컴 토스트 및 첫 번째 코스 제공
• 오후 8:30 - 행사 종료


## 호스트 소개

Turtle은 자산 발행사와 432,000명 이상의 검증된 온체인 LP 네트워크를 연결하는 유동성 분배 프로토콜입니다. 딜 소싱, 실사, 인센티브 분배, 빌링, LP 관계 관리까지 하나의 통합 플랫폼에서 지원하며, 모든 과정은 온체인에서 검증 가능합니다.

Turtle Group의 일원인 Lunar Strategy는 2019년부터 400개 이상의 프로젝트와 함께해 온 크립토 성장 에이전시로, 토큰 출시부터 생태계 캠페인까지 다양한 프로젝트의 성장을 지원해 왔습니다.

Compound는 DeFi의 기반을 다진 대표적인 렌딩 프로토콜 중 하나로, 온체인 머니마켓을 개척했으며 현재 Compound Foundation을 통해 생태계를 이끌어가고 있습니다.

단 20석만 마련됩니다. 참석자는 신청자 중 선별되며, 아래에서 신청해 주시면 검토 후 참석 확정 여부를 안내드립니다

## Event Overview

RaveDAO takes over SOAP Seoul, bringing together Seoul’s local rave community and the international Web3 crowd for a high-energy night of music, unexpected connections, and dancing until sunrise.

Headlining the night is BADDIEJUICE, Australia’s fast-rising genre-blending club force. She’ll be joined by a lineup of local Korean DJs at SOAP Seoul, a staple of Seoul nightlife and the first nightclub in Korea to become an official Apple Music Curator.

## For VIP table enquiries, please contact us:

Email: management@ravedao.com

About RaveDAO

RaveDAO is a global collective uniting music, technology, and purpose.

Since launching in Dubai in 2024, RaveDAO has expanded across Europe, the Middle East, North America, and Asia, hosting world-class events for over 100,000 attendees and collaborating with artists like Charlotte de Witte, Vintage Culture, Don Diablo, MORTEN, Chris Avantgarde, Lilly Palmer, Bassjackers, GENESI, and more.

With backing from partners such as Binance, OKX, Bitget, Bybit, WLFI, and Polygon, and collaborations with 1001Tracklists, AMF, and Warner Music, RaveDAO is building the future of on-chain entertainment, where fans, creators, and communities participate through verifiable identity and shared cultural ownership. Beyond music, RaveDAO channels its impact toward social good: proceeds in 2025 helped restore sight for 400+ cataract patients in Nepal and supported 150+ meditation and education programs across the U.S.

name: BNB Seoul
description:
## BNB Seoul is making a comeback!

BNB Chain is bringing our flagship side event to Korea Blockchain Week 2026, where we're closing out the week with the builders, founders, and investors behind the next wave of on-chain products.

Expect honest conversation about what is actually working on-chain, partner booths and activations running all day, and plenty of high-quality networking to send the week off right. It lands at the end of the busiest week in Korea's crypto calendar, in one room where you can see both what is getting built and where the market is heading.

If you're building, investing, or allocating in blockchain and AI, this is the room to be in during KBW.


## ​RSVP to secure your place.

Register under Standard to join us; VIP registration is reserved for our partners. We review applications on a rolling basis and approve as we go.

We're expecting a full house, and space at the venue is limited. Once approved, we recommend arriving early to guarantee smooth entry, as access on the day will be first-come, first-served.

Please note: parking is not provided at the venue, so plan your travel accordingly.

Follow BNB Chain on X (https://twitter.com/BNBCHAIN?utm_source=luma) for the latest updates.


## BNB 서울이 돌아옵니다.

코리아 블록체인 위크 2026 기간, BNB 체인의 플래그십 사이드 이벤트가 열립니다. 온체인 제품의 다음 흐름을 만들어가는 빌더와 파운더, 투자자가 한자리에 모여 한 주를 마무리합니다.

지금 온체인에서 실제로 통하고 있는 것에 대한 솔직한 이야기, 하루 종일 운영되는 파트너 부스와 액티베이션, 그리고 한 주를 제대로 닫아줄 여유 있는 네트워킹까지 이어집니다. 한 해 중 한국 크립토 씬이 가장 뜨거운 주간, 그 마지막을 장식하는 자리입니다. 무엇이 만들어지고 있고 시장은 어디로 움직이는지, 같은 공간에서 확인할 수 있습니다.


## RSVP로 자리를 확보해 주세요.

참가 신청은 Standard로 진행해 주세요. VIP 등록은 파트너 대상으로만 운영됩니다. 모든 신청은 검토 후 순차적으로 승인됩니다.

많은 분들이 찾아주실 것으로 예상되어 현장 수용 인원에 한계가 있습니다. 승인 후에도 당일 입장은 선착순으로 진행되니, 여유롭게 입장하시려면 조금 일찍 도착하시는 것을 권해드립니다.

현장에 별도의 주차 공간은 제공되지 않으니 방문 계획 시 참고해 주세요.

최신 소식은 X (https://x.com/BNBCHAIN)에서 BNB 체인 계정을 통해서 확인해보세요.

name: Enter the Night: with Midnight Korea
description:

## ✨Enter the Night


> 9월 한 달간 진행된 Midnight Korea Hackathon 2026 (https://luma.com/2pnv2fwk)의 결과물이 Korea Blockchain Week 기간 서울에서 공개됩니다.
> 
> 해커톤 우승 3팀의 라이브 데모부터 프라이버시와 보안을 둘러싼 기관 세션, 그리고 빌더·기업·투자자·커뮤니티가 함께하는 네트워킹까지.
> 
> Enter the Night은 한 달간의 빌드를 마무리하고, 프라이버시 기술을 만들고 활용하는 사람들이 한자리에 모이는 Korea Blockchain Week 2026 사이드 이벤트입니다.


## 📌 행사 개요

📅일시


• 2026년 10월 2일 금요일 · 17:00–20:00 KST

📍장소


• 승인된 참석자에 한해 안내드릴 예정입니다.

🎟 행사 구성


• 해커톤 데모데이
• 프로젝트, 기관 세션 (Midnight, CertiK, SFL)
• 커뮤니티 네트워킹

👥 정원: 100명

*행사는 Korea Blockchain Week 2026 기간인 10월 2일 금요일 개최되며, 승인 후 참석이 확정됩니다.


## 🚀 한 달간의 빌드, 수상팀의 프로젝트가 공개됩니다

9월 한 달 동안 참가 팀들은 4주간의 온라인 해커톤을 통해 Midnight 위에서 프라이버시 중심 DApp을 만들었습니다.

Enter the Night은 그 과정의 결과물이 공개되는 자리입니다. 최종 선정된 우승 3팀이 직접 무대에 올라 무엇을 만들었고, 어떤 문제를 풀고자 했는지 보여줍니다.

그리고 그 결과물을 중심으로 프라이버시 기술을 만드는 빌더, 이를 검토하고 도입하는 기업과 기관, 투자자와 Web3 커뮤니티가 한 공간에서 만납니다.

개발자나 해커톤 참가자가 아니어도 참석할 수 있습니다.


## 👀 행사는 어떻게 진행되나요?

Demo Day


• Midnight Korea Hackathon 2026 우승 3팀이 직접 무대에 올라 프로젝트를 소개하고 라이브 데모를 선보입니다.
• 한 달간의 빌드가 실제 제품과 아이디어로 어떻게 이어졌는지 만나보세요.

Privacy, Security & Institutional Perspectives


• Midnight과 CertiK이 프라이버시, 보안, 그리고 기술의 실제 도입 가능성을 각자의 관점에서 이야기합니다.
• 빌더가 만들어낸 결과물과 보안·기관 생태계의 시각을 한자리에서 연결합니다.

Community Networking


• 데모와 세션 이후에는 빌더, 창업자, 기업·기관 관계자, 투자자, 미디어와 Web3 커뮤니티가 자유롭게 교류합니다.
• 새로운 프로젝트를 발견하고, 협업 가능성을 찾고, KBW의 밤을 이어가세요.


## 🤝 이런 분들을 만날 수 있습니다


• 금융기관 및 엔터프라이즈 관계자
• Web3 창업자 및 생태계 팀
• 프라이버시·ZK 기술을 다루는 빌더
• 투자자 및 생태계 파트너
• 미디어 및 Web3 커뮤니티


## 🏆우승 팀 소개

Midnight Korea Hackathon 2026의 최종 심사를 통해 선정된 우승 3팀이 Enter the Night 무대에 오릅니다.

팀과 프로젝트는 최종 결과 발표 후 공개됩니다.
